description.value:
Pieces of junk clamp around the target's limbs, locking them in place like a series of makeshift manacles. The target must attempt a Reflex saving throw.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Suppressed] for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} and suppressed for 1 hour.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Restrained] and drops all items it's holding in its space. The restraints' [[/act force-open]] and [[/act escape]] DCs are equal to your spell DC. A creature can attack the restraints in an attempt to break its grip. The restraints have AC equal to your spell DC, Hardness 5, and 20 Hit Points. Destroying, Forcing Open, or Escaping from the restraints ends the spell.

Heightened (3rd) The junk has Hardness 8 and 66 Hit Points.

Heightened (5th) The junk has Hardness 8 and 88 Hit Points.

Heightened (8th) The junk has Hardness 10 and 100 Hit Points.
